name: Velvet Bite: Softly, With Teeth
source:
You've been invited to a Halloween party! Yay!
Music! Food! Drinks! Vampires!
Wait. VAMPIRES!?

A Romantic Visual Novel featuring 6 romanceable vampires.

[From [url=https://everium.itch.io/velvetbite]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你已被邀请参加万圣节派对！耶！
音乐！食物！饮料！吸血鬼！
等待。吸血鬼！？

一部以6个浪漫吸血鬼为主角的浪漫视觉小说。

[来自[url=https://everium.itch.io/velvetbite]itch.io[/url]]
